visualCharacteristics: New: full-content-width responsive iframe embed for providers the library embed does not cover (Brightcove bcove.video player, Google Maps embed), with a skip link before the iframe.
contentPattern: Embedded third-party player: an interactive component.
Embedded third-party map: an interactive component.

usage.description: Responsive 16:9 iframe for a Brightcove video (bcove.video short link) or a Google Maps embed URL, with a keyboard skip link; loads when scrolled into view, or on click when a poster image is authored.

reuseGuidance: Use for Brightcove videos, Google Maps place embeds and other iframe-able URLs. Use the standard embed block for YouTube, Vimeo and social posts.
tableStructure: One row, one cell: the embed URL as a link (https://bcove.video/... or https://www.google.com/maps/embed/v1/place?...); optionally a poster image in the same cell for click-to-load
